sn37.13:1.1: Pañcahi Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātu gāmo || la || nirayam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || Assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottāpī ca hoti muṭṭhassati ca hoti duppañño ca hoti || || Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || nirayam upapajjatī ti || ||
